Card Q&A.a: Yes, it triggers.  In addition, the "if played or digivolved by an effect" condition will be met if it was played or digivolved by an effect.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself is played or when one of my Digimon in the battle area would digivolve into this card?
Only suspended Digimon are in the battle area.  Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when a Digimon is played or digivolves?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  This effect's [Once Per Turn] has already been used upon the 1st activation, therefore it can't activate again.
Card Q&A.q: I activated this card's [All Turns] effect when a method other than an effect played or digivolved a Digimon.  Can I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect again when an effect plays or digivolves a Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  If a Digimon is played or digivolved by an effect, you must delete an opponent's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not activate this card's [All Turns] effect when an effect plays or digivolves a Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: Yes.If the Digimon isn't played or digivolved by an effect and you don't process the "you may suspend" effect to use the [Once Per Turn] limit, it triggers the next time a Digimon is played or digivolved.If the Digimon is played or digivolved by an effect, the condition "if played or digivolved by an effect" is met even if you don't process the "you may suspend" effect, requiring the delete effect to be processed which uses the [Once Per Turn] limit.
Card Q&A.q: If I don't activate this card's [All Turns] effect when a Digimon is played or digivolved by some method other than an effect, can I activate it later when another Digimon is played or digivolved?

Effect: When this card would be played, if there are 12 or more levels' total worth of Digimon, reduce the cost by 5.
